integrity: The proof derives the infinite statement using fixed-modulus CRT second moments and the prime number theorem in arithmetic progressions. Standalone calculations check only local finite identities. No external or independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Sufficient zero-density theorem only; the critical logarithmic exponent is not claimed necessary or optimal. No result for singular discriminant or noncoercive forms. Full source text of the Dai--Pan positive-density article was unavailable; priority may have unindexed precursors.
title: A borderline-sparsity zero-density theorem for multi-shift quadratic Romanoff sets
